entities.summary: Yang Jingnian was a performers & entertainers in Miluo City (1908-10-17, Miluo City – 2016-09-04) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
